title: Sysmon Advanced Endpoint Telemetry Service is Not Installed or Inactive
description: Microsoft Sysinternals System Monitor (Sysmon) provides deep kernel-level event telemetry for process injection, network connections, file creation time tampering, and WMI events.
expected: Sysmon / Sysmon64 service is Running with active configuration
impact: Advanced living-off-the-land techniques (e.g. process hollowing, unmanaged PowerShell, reflective DLL injection) cannot be investigated post-intrusion.
remediation_guidance: Deploy Sysmon with a vetted configuration (e.g. SwiftOnSecurity or Olaf Hartong Modular configuration): sysmon -i config.xml
